title: Leveraging In-Context Learning for Political Bias Testing of LLMs

bias_targets.methodology: Questionnaire Modeling (QM) task using Monte Carlo sampling over human survey data as in-context examples to predict answers to political attitude statements, measuring the divergence of the model's expected predictions from the human population mean.
Analyzing the systematic preference of models for specific output tokens (e.g., disproportionately predicting 'no' over 'yes') regardless of the input question's content.
